summary: Opened Nitrosend's v0 template gallery, used the Nitrosend Original night_run design, saved a customized Cian-owned Nitrosend template (27691), and sent it by template_id through the Nitrosend MCP server to proof@dogfood.nitrosend.net. Nitrosend published a signed runx receipt for the MCP send. The v0 like button was attempted but Vercel required SMS phone verification on the account, so no like was recorded.
